notes.title: 0.2408.3101 Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
The game map now kicks off in classic platformer style!

You can set up your own private lobby and dive into thrilling 1v1 or 3v3 PvP action.

The objective remains unchanged: snatch the flag from the center and sprint to the opponent's base to score. First team to hit 3 points in a best-of-5 series claims victory.

So, gear up to fight, dodge, and dash your way to glory. Have a blast!


[b]Movement Controls[/b]

A - Move left
D - Move right
Space - Jump
L Shift - Dash
Hold F - Pick up or drop the flag

notes.title: 0.2406.3001 - New Gameplay Updates
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The new ability, [b]Berserk[/b], requires a 10-second charge and grants super speed for 10 seconds afterward.
[*] The first team to score in a [b]best-of-five[/b] game series wins.
[*] The dash skill only activates when you're the flag bearer.
[*] Players can now pick up and drop the flag.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access v0.2405.1905
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903776/f275fd9acb12e724a3c055a1dc8157b896c12cc6.png[/img]

Hey, everyone! Early access to my game, Flagdashers, is here! I'm thrilled to share this exciting milestone with you all.

The core game mechanics are available, and you can enjoy both private lobbies and public matchmaking. Gather your friends or find new challengers online and dive into the action.

The game isn't perfect, and I appreciate your feedback. Please send any issues or suggestions to robert@flagdashers.com, and I'll address them ASAP. For unsupported game server regions, please reach out and join the Discord for quick turnaround time with support.

Thanks for your support!
